Description

2011 Topps Chrome, a 220-card parallel brand, was released on September 7th, 2011. As with previous years, the set features 170 cards recycled from the 2011 Topps Baseball base set, with 50 rookies -- some of which are autographed. Each Hobby box should yield two rookie autographs. The usual slew of Refractor parallels return, along with the addition of a 110-card Black-bordered Refractor partial parallel.

Due to quality control issues with the previous year's product, Topps used a different contractor to produce this year's Chrome. While this new contractor was able to solve the "bowing" issues with the cards, unfortunately, they did not etch the card's chromium layer. (It's this layer that gives the Chrome brand its shine) As a result, this year's Chrome looked flat and drab.

Distribution

Hobby: 24 packs per box, 4 cards per pack (MSRP: $3.00)

Retail: 4 cards per pack (MSRP: $2.99)

Rack packs: Three, 4-card retail packs plus three Orange Refractors (MSRP: $8.99)

USA Baseball Refractors

Randomly inserted into Hobby packs are redemption cards good for a pack of six cards from a 22-card set of the 2011 USA Baseball Collegiate National Team. All "base" cards are Refractors and each card is serial-numbered to 999 copies.

Redemption cards expired September 6th, 2012.

Randomly inserted into these packs are autographs (see below) and the following Refractor parallels.

  • Blue Refractor (serial-numbered to 499 copies)
  • Gold Refractor (serial-numbered to 50 copies)
  • Diamond Die-Cut Atomic Refractor (serial-numbered to ten copies)
  • Red Refractor (serial-numbered to five copies)
  • SuperFractor (one-of-one)
  • Printing Plates (four-for-each)

USA Baseball Refractor Autographs

Randomly inserted into Hobby packs are redemption cards good for a pack of five or six autographed cards from the 22-card USA Baseball Collegiate National Team set. The checklist is identical to that of the unautographed insert (see above). Each card is also available in the following Refractor parallels.

  • Refractor (serial-numbered to 199 copies)
  • Blue Refractor (serial-numbered to 99 copies)
  • Gold Refractor (serial-numbered to 50 copies)
  • Diamond Die-Cut Atomic Refractor (serial-numbered to ten copies)
  • Red Refractor (serial-numbered to five copies)
  • Super-Fractor (one-of-one)
  • Printing Plates (four-for-each)
